NEW · QAFILA DESIGN STUDIOS

Design it. Simulate it. Revise it.

CAD-style 3D studios that start from an empty plot. Answer a short brief and the studio drafts a full layout, then lets you move every object, run a 4D shift and save revisions for review.

CAD · 3D · 4D

Warehouse Design Studio

12 warehouse types, from bonded to cold and automated. Size, product, shipments, 40+ technologies and facilities become a 3D design with KPIs, compliance checks and costs.

  • AS/RS · VNA · shuttle · cube robots · AMR
  • Docks, offices, cold rooms, DG cages
  • 4D shift · AI review · revisions

Production Line Design Studio

Seven industries and five process types. Choose lines, automation, quality gates and packaging; the studio balances every station to takt and runs the line with live andon lights.

  • Yamazumi chart · bottleneck · OEE

WHY A CARAVAN

Long before containers, there was the قافلة.

Caravans carried goods across Arabia for centuries: the region's first supply chains. Qafila carries that idea forward with AI, simulation and open data.

THE MIND BEHIND QAFILA

Dr. Mohammad Alsmairat

Associate Professor of Supply Chain & Quality Management · Hamdan Bin Mohammad Smart University, Dubai

QAFILA was designed by Dr. Mohammad Alsmairat to turn supply chain theory into something you can see, play and test. A Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) with a PhD in Supply Chain Management, he brings more than fifteen years of teaching, research and consulting across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Jordan. His 30+ Scopus-indexed articles, mostly in Q1 journals, span supply chain resilience, Quality 4.0 and 5.0, Lean Six Sigma, Industry 5.0 and AI in operations. He is Principal Investigator on a Dubai RDI-funded project localizing large language models to Arabic norms and culture.
